newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares steady, eye Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares steady, eye Telecom.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Shares recovered much of their earlier losses, helped by Portugal Telecom. Market mood on Thursday likely to be influenced by how investors react to Telecom's first half results to be issued in the morning.
*PSI-20 .PSI20 index ends 0.05 percent down at 4,762.94 with overall cash trade an active four billion escudos.

*Analysts expect Portugal Telecom to post consolidated net profit of between 20 and 26 billion escudos for the first six months of the year, generally above the 20.7 billion forecast made by the company itself two months ago.
*Sonae Investimento was dominated by movements of shares within the group. The holding has announced it needs 20,000 more of its own shares to bring the total accumulated recently to one million.
